name: EASA final energy reserve (5 min) - NECESSARY CONDITION ONLY
cite: AMC4 UAM.OP.VCA.191(b), Annex VI to ED Decision 2025/010/R (under Reg. (EU) 2024/1111): final reserve 'at least 5 minutes flying time at a VCA configuration and speed appropriate for a go-around and approach procedure'
condition_note: EASA's full requirement is a mission energy PLAN plus this final reserve; auditing the final reserve alone is a NECESSARY condition - a REFUTED here refutes the full rule, a CERTIFIED does not certify it. Go-around/approach power is enclosed by the hover box (conservative). Stated on the page.
